On August 26, 2026, members of our team attended the “Positively Open” support group session hosted by @truevolutioninc Participants included both younger and older members of the community living with HIV. Researchers shared a presentation on both published and ongoing projects within the current landscape of HIV/AIDS research in Inland Southern California. Afterwards, our team facilitated a discussion where support group members shared their perspectives living with HIV, as well as feedback on ongoing and proposed studies by our lab. 

Huge thank you to TruEvolution for helping us coordinate this presentation! There’s no greater fulfillment than to be able to discuss and improve upon our projects through direct conversation with members of the community we serve.
